exchanges: what a week and its only wednesday
Oof, hang in there, the weekend's coming.
long day at the hospital, being a sonographer is not as calm as people think
I bet, it must take a lot of focus all day.
got home and the house looked like a tornado went through
Ha, the joys of coming home to chaos.
my youngest thaddeus has decided he only eats beige food now
Ha, the beige phase is a rite of passage.
pasta, toast, plain rice. thats the whole menu
Well, at least it's easy to cook!
and our cat brisket knocked my coffee off the counter this morning
Cats really do love gravity experiments.
zero remorse, just stared at me
Classic cat energy.
youd think a ragdoll would be the chill type but nope, pure menace
Ha, so much for the breed's reputation!
work drama today too, the parking situation is a mess
Parking battles are the worst way to start a shift.
cass from work just got a tundra and it barely fits in a space lol
Ha, that's a lot of truck for a hospital lot.
funny bc the other cass, the one next door, drives this tiny kona
Ha, opposite ends of the size scale.
i should really get to bed earlier
Sleep is always a good idea, especially this week.
my husband grew up in glenvarra and still talks about it like its paradise
Ha, everyone's hometown is the best one in their eyes.
we might visit his parents there in the summer
That sounds like a nice trip.
my husband's at fencing again tonight so im on bath duty
Ha, enjoy the splash zone.
the kids think hes a pirate when he practices in the garden
That's adorable, a backyard sword show.
my mum's got shingles, poor thing, shes miserable
Oh no, I hope she feels better soon.
gonna drop soup off for her tomorrow
That's really kind of you, she'll appreciate it.
watching taskmaster after the kids are down, best part of my day
Sounds like the perfect way to unwind.
petra at work swears by her fairphone, she repairs it herself
That's impressive, a very handy skill.
she's trying to convert the whole ward lol
Ha, a true evangelist.
date night at tamarind on friday, its our favourite spot
Lovely, enjoy a night off together!
already arranged a sitter, miracles happen
Ha, well done, that's half the battle.
ok bath time, wish me luck
Good luck, stay dry!
